# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before generating or modifying code, read the project specification:

`copilot_instructions.md`

Treat this document as the primary architectural and functional reference.

Follow the defined architecture, technology stack, financial accounting rules,
security requirements and development milestones.

Inspect existing code before proposing modifications.

Implement features incrementally and include appropriate tests.

Do not introduce architectural changes without explaining their benefits
and obtaining approval.
